Name: HealAssist
Author: monkdim
Punchline: One button raise targeting and lowest HP targeting for healers.
Description:
HealAssist gives you two commands built for hotbar macros or crossbar slots.

/harez targets the highest priority raisable dead player, using a priority list you build yourself out of roles and specific character names.
/halow targets the player with the lowest HP percentage.

HealAssist only changes your target. Your macro casts the spell, so the game's own cast and queue rules apply exactly as if you had clicked the party member yourself. An opt-in setting can have the plugin fire the raise for you instead.

Both commands can optionally consider the wider alliance, or any player sharing the zone with you, which covers field operations such as Occult Crescent where the people who need raising are in no party of yours.
